subject: Post-call: SOC2 / Pen Test Report + Vulnerability Management Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@finhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: SOC2 / Pen Test Report + Vulnerability Management Next Steps

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for taking the intro call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- SOC 2: you asked whether Redwood is SOC 2 Type II covered and whether we can provide a summary report. We are SOC 2 Type II compliant; I attached a one-page summary and we can share the full report under an NDA.
- Pen test: you mentioned compliance needs for your vendor review. Our standard practice is to provide a pen test summary and a remediation timeline outline.
- Vulnerability management: Rishi (cc'd) will share details on scan cadence, SLA for remediation, and our disclosure policy.

Next steps:
1) I'll send over the SOC 2 summary and our pen test summary (attached).
2) Rishi — can you confirm cadence (internal scanning schedule + external third-party scans), SLA targets for critical/high/medium findings, and whether we can accept a shared risk assessment?
3) Tom / Asha — please share the vendor questionnaire or key fields you want us to populate; we can either fill your spreadsheet or provide a link to our security portal.

Appreciate it — happy to schedule a 30-min follow-up with product/security if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_summary_2026.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@finhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC2 / Pen Test Report + Vulnerability Management Next Steps

Hi Tom — nice to meet you over email. Quick answers on the items you asked about: 

1) Pen test: last third-party penetration test was conducted by BrightWave Security on 2026-08-10. We can share the executive summary and a redacted findings report; we do not share raw exploit POCs in vendor disclosures.

2) Scan cadence:
   - Internal automated scans: weekly (SAST/DAST + dependency checks).
   - External third-party pen test: annual (large release windows may trigger additional engagements).
   - Vulnerability scans for infra/container images: nightly via our CI pipeline.

3) SLA & remediation targets (example):
   - Critical: 24-72 hours to mitigation plan; aim for remediation in 7 days (depends on customer-impact assessment).
   - High: mitigation plan in 3 business days; remediation within 30 days.
   - Medium/Low: tracked in backlog with SLA 90 days for medium.

4) Disclosure & reporting: we provide customers with an executive pen test summary and a remediation tracker. For customers with elevated requirements we will coordinate an on-site readout or a scoped SOC2+ questionnaire.

We can also complete the Excel VSAQ you mentioned — Marissa, can you add the FinHealth file to the thread so Rishi can start filling?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2026.pdf]

Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC2 / Pen Test Report + Vulnerability Management Next Steps

Thanks team — received the SOC2 and pen test summary and reviewed initial VSAQ responses. A couple quick clarifications from our risk team after glancing at the pen test summary: 

- For the critical SLA window, can you confirm whether the 24-72 hour 'mitigation plan' target includes the time to produce a patch or just the time to triage and produce a documented mitigation plan? Our procurement wants clarity on whether the SLA is 'plan' vs 'remediation'.
- Can you share the typical timeframe between detection in nightly scans and customer notification if there is potential customer data exposure?

If you can confirm those two items before our call on 12/22, that'll help expedite procurement.

Best,
Asha
Vendor Risk Analyst
FinHealth
